question: What critical event is said to occur at the moment of the body's fall?
premises: The time of bodily death is specified
A splitting of the skull is described as occurring then
inference: At the fall of the body, the skull is said to split at that moment
uncertainties: The doctrinal meaning of the skull splitting is not explicit in this verse alone
plain_english: O Goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is split.
